title: Japan and South Korea Face Off Again in the US Navy’s Frigate Search
author: Takahashi Kosuke
text:
Japan’s upgraded Mogami-class frigate, the New FFM (left), and South Korea’s Chungnam-class frigate
Credit: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries and HD Hyundai Heavy Industries
The U.S. Navy’s reported interest in foreign frigate designs has opened a new front in Japan-South Korea defense industrial competition. USNI News reported on September 1 that the White House and Navy are considering three allied designs: Japan’s upgraded Mogami class, known as the New FFM or 06FFM; South Korea’s Chungnam class; and Turkiye’s Istanbul class. Up to two ships could be built overseas before production shifts to U.S. yards.The idea did not come from nowhere. As Naval News reported in June, the Pentagon’s fiscal year 2027 budget proposal included $1.85 billion for an effort involving foreign warship designs, with Japan and South Korea at the center of the discussion.[...]
